v1_human_g3_exception: If duration is longer than length of day, return []

v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: Accept a list of existing events
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: Treat slots on blocking the entire interval
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_4: Return start times in HH:MM format
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_6: Handle multiple events in a day

v1_human_g3_goal: Valid start time for a given date based on existing calendar entry, and a record meeting duration.
v1_human_g3_input: Existing events, list/array, starting time 0 < H:H < 23, 100 < MM < 60, meeting duration, int, > 0

v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_1: Conflict is always sorted in a steady order
v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_2: All start times are within working hours

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: System must not return any start time that would overlap on other meeting
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: Not subject start time outside of working hours

v1_human_g3_output: List of start times in string
v1_human_g3_tie_breaking: Return all feasible slots, must prioritize earlier shift times
